notes:
- Compare two versions of a PDF: choose the original and the revised copy, and Paperly shows the
  pages side by side with the changed wording marked, struck through in red where it was removed
  and green where it was added. Added and removed pages are listed too, and you can step from one
  change to the next. Both files stay unchanged.
- Blacking out text in a PDF made on a Mac (Pages, Preview, Print to PDF) or printed from Chrome
  now removes only the words under your box. The rest of the page stays text you can select and
  search, where before the whole page became a picture.
